steps.title: Deployment Architecture
steps.text: Deploy Surgewave from local Docker Compose environments through staging Kubernetes clusters to production multi-region setups with TLS and high availability.

steps.title: Docker Multi-Stage Builds
steps.text: Containerize Surgewave apps with multi-stage Dockerfiles that produce minimal runtime images. Lesson 14.1 covers Dockerfile best practices.

steps.title: Kubernetes Resources
steps.text: Use Deployments for stateless producers and consumers, StatefulSets for brokers, Services for discovery, ConfigMaps for settings, and Secrets for credentials.

steps.title: Environment Configuration
steps.text: Surgewave supports layered configuration: command-line arguments, environment variables, ConfigMaps, appsettings.json, and code defaults, in priority order.

steps.title: Cloud Providers
steps.text: Understand considerations for AWS (EKS, MSK), Azure (AKS, Event Hubs), and GCP (GKE, Pub/Sub) when deploying Surgewave to cloud environments.
